help.allPositionsSelectedInspectionClickPosit: All positions are selected for inspection. Click a position to leave it out.
help.answerQuestionsSeeRecommendation: Answer the questions to see the recommendation.
help.cancelsToLowerCaseWorkOrder: This cancels the {{toLowerCase}} and its Work Order
help.changesPositionListConfigurationCurrentV: Changes to the position list of this configuration (the current version keeps its positions as history)
help.checkBulgesDeformationSignsTireLayers: Check for bulges, deformation or signs that the tire layers are separating. A finding can indicate casing, belt or ply damage.
help.checkLeaksPenetrationForeignObjectSuch: Check for leaks or penetration by a foreign object such as a nail, screw or other object.
help.checkRepairsDoneBeforeWhetherThey: Check repairs done before and whether they still meet the repair standard.
help.checkWhetherReinforcingCordsSteelWires: Check whether the reinforcing cords / steel wires are visible, broken or corroded. This concerns the tire's structural integrity.
help.chooseVehicleWheelsConfigurationSeeTire: Choose a vehicle with a Wheels Configuration to see its tire positions.
help.clickPositionsReplaceOneMoreClick: Click the positions to replace (one or more). Click again to unselect.
help.clickVehicleMoveBetweenTablesChanges: Click a vehicle to move it between the tables. Changes are saved only when you press Save.
help.conditionBeadPartTireSeatsRim: Condition of the bead — the part of the tire that seats on the rim. Check for abrasion, tearing, deformation and an exposed or damaged bead wire.
help.conditionInnerLayerHelpsHoldAir: Condition of the inner layer that helps hold the air pressure. It can reveal internal damage that is not visible from the outside.
help.conditionTireSSideWallSurface: Condition of the tire's side wall: surface abrasion, cracking, cuts and deeper damage.
help.configCodeAppearsWhenEveryField: The Config Code appears when every field is valid and there is at least one front and one rear axle.
help.configurationConfigCodeAlreadyExistsVehi: Configuration {{config_code}} already exists for this vehicle type.
help.configurationNewerVersionConfigCodeVehic: This configuration has a newer version ({{config_code}}). The vehicle stays on v{{version_number}} until it is updated in Vehicle Mapping.
help.degradationAgeChemicalExposureSuchRubber: Degradation from age or chemical exposure, such as rubber hardening, brittleness, softening, swelling or cracking.
help.dMinLowestTreadDepthMm: D_min — the lowest tread depth (mm) of all measured points: D_min = min(all tread depth measurements). One of the main inputs of the inspection decision.
help.dNewReferenceTreadDepthMm: D_new — the reference tread depth (mm) when the tire was new, or after its last retread. Used as the baseline for the remaining tread percentage when available.
help.dotDateCodeProductionWeek2: DOT date code: production week + 2-digit year. Saved on the physical tire; Tire Age is recalculated.
help.dPullPlannedRemovalTreadDepth: D_pull — the planned removal tread depth (mm): the threshold at which the fleet pulls a tire from service before it reaches the legal / minimum D_service. D_pull must be ≥ D_service. Adjusted per tire category in Tire Management → Inspection Rules (the active rule profile).
help.editingVersionVersionNumberConfigCode: Editing version {{version_number}} ({{config_code}}). Saving a change creates version {{value}}. Vehicle Type and Truck Configuration Type identify this configuration and cannot be changed — create a new configuration for another type.
help.fileMayNotLargerThan5: The file may not be larger than 5 MB.
help.greenOutlineTireRegisteredInstalledCount: green outline = tire registered ({{installedCount}} of {{positionsCount}} positions).
help.historySignsTireRanVeryLow: History or signs that the tire ran with very low pressure, leaking or overheated, which can cause internal casing damage.
help.importedImportedNewStockFailedCount: {{imported}} imported to New Stock, {{failedCount}} not imported — see the rows below.
help.installRotateInspectTiresEachAction: Install, rotate and inspect tires. Each action opens the tire, where the step is recorded.
help.jpgPngMax3MbEach: JPG / PNG, max 3 MB each. Uploaded when the inspection is submitted.
help.least6Points3CircumferentialZones: At least 6 points: 3 circumferential zones × main groove inner / outer (center / most worn optional). Do not measure on the wear indicator.
help.mappedVehicleCountMappedVehicleS: {{mapped_vehicle_count}} mapped vehicle(s) stay on their current version until updated in Vehicle Mapping.
help.mappedVehicleCountVehicleSMapped: {{mapped_vehicle_count}} vehicle(s) are mapped to this configuration. They keep their current version; move them to the new version from Vehicle Mapping when ready.
help.maxMaximumTireAgeServiceMonths: A_max — maximum tire age for service (months)
help.missingTireDataNotice: <position>{{position}}</position> has no tire data yet. Complete it in <link>Vehicle Details → Wheels Configuration</link> before continuing.
help.newStockReuseUsedTiresBack: (New Stock, or Reuse — used tires back in stock after inspection in Used Tire Management) are listed. Both are requested and issued through the Work Order's Part Request (Reuse as a Used line).
help.noActiveRuleProfileTireManagement: · no active rule profile (Tire Management → Inspection Rules)
help.noneNoActiveProfileTireCategory: None — no active profile for this tire category
help.notListedIncompleteVehicleDataVehicle: Not listed: {{incomplete_vehicle_data}} vehicle(s) without Vehicle Type, Axles or Wheels on their Vehicle Detail, and {{mapped_to_other_configuration}} vehicle(s) mapped to another configuration (remove them there first).
help.onceDownloadTemplateFillSheet: at once. Download the template, fill the sheet
help.onlyExcelFilesXlsxImported: Only Excel files (.xlsx) can be imported.
help.onlyRemovedHoldTireInspectedHere: Only a REMOVED or HOLD tire is inspected here — this tire is {{current_status}}.
help.overviewEditSpecificationsFirstSoVehicle: in Overview → Edit Specifications first so the vehicle can be matched.
help.productDeletedTiresTheirHistoryStay: This product was deleted. Its tires and their history stay available here.
help.productNoTireSpecificationYetComplete: This product has no tire specification yet — complete it with Edit Product first.
help.registeredNowListedTireManagementTire: registered. It is now listed in Tire Management → Tire List.
help.registerTireCurrentlyPositionLastKnown: Register the tire currently on this position (last known data). Warehouse stock is not affected.
help.removeTransferTheseTiresFirst: Remove or transfer these tires first.
help.replacementRotationInspectionJobsEachOne: Replacement, rotation and inspection jobs. Each one is carried out through the Work Order created with it.
help.resultFurtherExaminationSpecialistRetrea: The result of a further examination by a specialist / retreader, when the decision cannot be made from the fleet inspection alone.
help.retreadMaxMaximumCasingAgeRetread: A_retread_max — maximum casing age for retread (months)
help.ruleProfileNameVVersionD: Rule profile: {{name}} (v{{version}}) — D_service {{d_service_mm}} mm, D_pull {{d_pull_mm}} mm, A_max {{a_max_months}} mo, A_retread_max {{a_retread_max_months}} mo, N_retread_max {{n_retread_max}}
help.sameVehicleTypeTotalAxlesAxles: Same vehicle type, {{total_axles}} axles and {{total_wheels}} wheels (incl. spare), not mapped to any configuration.
help.selectPositionPreviewListViewRegister: Select a position on the preview or in this list to view or register its tire.
help.selectTruckConfigurationTypeConfigureAxl: Select the truck configuration type to configure its axles and wheels.
help.selectVehicleTypeConfigureAxlesWheels: Select a vehicle type to configure its axles and wheels.
help.serialNumberManufactureDateCodePurchase: (Serial Number, Manufacture Date Code, Purchase Date) and upload it.
help.specificationComesProductAppliedRegister: The specification comes from this product and is applied to the registered tire.
help.step1ChooseTirePositionRotated: Step 1 — Choose your Tire Position to be rotated
help.step2RotatingTirePendingSelected: Step 2 — Rotating the tire with… ({{pending}} selected)
help.submittingRecordsInspectionRecommendatio: Submitting records this inspection with its recommendation. The tire keeps its status until the disposition is approved.
help.tapTireViewRegister: Tap a tire to view or register it.
help.thresholdsUsedTireInspectionPerTire: Thresholds for used tire inspection per tire category. Passenger / Light Truck, Truck / Bus and OTR / Heavy Equipment rules are never mixed; a profile for a specific tire product or application takes precedence over the general one.
help.tireHoldInspectAgainOnceOpen: This tire is on HOLD — inspect it again once the open items are resolved.
help.tireRemovedVehicleWaitsUsedTire: This tire was removed from a vehicle and waits for its Used Tire Management inspection.
help.tiresRemovedServiceRemovedTiresWait: Tires removed from service: removed tires wait here for inspection before they return to stock as Used; retread or scrap them. Tires removed with disposition Retread or Repair appear under Retread; each action opens the tire.
help.treadDepthMmCenterTreadPoint: Tread depth (mm) at the center of the tread or at the point that visibly looks the most worn. Captures the lowest tread that the inner / outer grooves may miss.
help.treadDepthMmMeasuredMainGroove: Tread depth (mm) measured in the main groove on the inner side of the tire. Captures inner-side wear and helps detect uneven wear.
help.treadDepthMmMeasuredMainGroove2: Tread depth (mm) measured in the main groove on the outer side of the tire. Compared with the inner groove to read the wear pattern.
help.treadLifeIndicatorOnlyNotSafety: (tread life indicator only — not a safety score or remaining KM)
help.treadWearPatternEvenOneSided: The tread wear pattern — even, one-sided, center, both sides, cupping / scalloping or flat spot. Abnormal wear helps reveal alignment, suspension, inflation pressure or load problems.
help.vehicleCannotRemappedBecauseActiveTires: Vehicle cannot be remapped because active tires are installed on positions removed by the target configuration.
help.vehicleDoesNotWheelsConfigurationPlease: This vehicle does not have a Wheels Configuration. Please map a Wheels Configuration first.
help.vehicleFollowUpNotFixedTire: Vehicle follow-up (not fixed by a tire repair)
help.vehicleNoWheelsConfigurationMapped: This vehicle has no Wheels Configuration mapped.
help.waitingApprovalTireKeepsCurrentStatus: Waiting for approval — the tire keeps its current status until then.
help.waitingApproverPermissionApproveUsedTire: Waiting for an approver (permission “Approve used tire inspection dispositions”).
help.wheelsConfigurationAssignedConfiguration: A wheels configuration is assigned from the configuration's Vehicle Mapping page. Open the list to find a configuration that matches this vehicle.
help.wheelsConfigurationConfigCodeVVersion: Wheels Configuration {{config_code}} (v{{version_number}}) — this tire is on
help.whetherTireSAgeRetreadCount: Whether the tire's age, retread count and casing condition still meet the limits that apply to this tire category / model (the active Inspection Rules profile).
help.youDoNotPermissionInspectTires: You do not have permission to inspect tires.
help.zone1FirstMeasurementAreaAround: Zone 1 — the first measurement area around the tire's circumference. Measuring in 3 different areas (not just one spot) makes sure the reading represents the whole tread.
help.zone2SecondMeasurementAreaAround: Zone 2 — the second measurement area around the tire's circumference, away from Zone 1.
help.zone3ThirdMeasurementAreaAround: Zone 3 — the third measurement area around the tire's circumference, away from Zones 1 and 2.

labels.enterDotDateCode4Digits: Enter the DOT date code as 4 digits WWYY (production week 01–53 and two-digit year), e.g. 1225 = week 12 of 2025, not in the future.

labels.n1FillSheetFillHereOne: 1. Fill the sheet "Fill Here": one tire per row, starting on row 2. Do not rename the sheets or change the header row.
labels.n2SerialNumberRequiredSerialPrinted: 2. Serial Number (required): the serial printed on the tire, at most 100 characters. It must not be registered yet for your company — letter case and surrounding spaces are ignored when comparing.
labels.n3ManufactureDateCodeOptionalDot: 3. Manufacture Date Code (optional): the DOT week/year code, at most 20 characters — e.g. 2326 = week 23 of 2026.
labels.n4PurchaseDateOptionalDateWritten: 4. Purchase Date (optional): a date, written as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-07-01).
labels.n5TireSpecificationSizePatternLoad: 5. The tire specification (size, pattern, load index…) comes from this product; every imported tire is registered as New Stock.
labels.n6SaveFileXlsxThenTire: 6. Save the file as .xlsx, then in Tire Detail → New Stock → Import, upload it, review the preview, select the rows to import and confirm.
labels.purchaseDateMustDateYyyyMm: Purchase Date must be a date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
